虽然许多中国媒体报道发射地点是渤海，导弹可能是新型的巨浪3，但台湾国防部根据“多方情资”指出，中国发射的是巨浪2，射程6000至7000公里，由南海海面发射，飞越菲律宾上空。

articles.title_original: BYD launches the Dolphin G plug-in hatch with 65 miles of EV range for $32,000
articles.title_zh: 比亚迪发布海豚G插电混动版，纯电续航65英里，售价3.2万美元
articles.summary: The Dolphin G DM-i is BYD’s first car specifically designed for Europe. With up to 65 miles of pure electric range and 646 miles combined, BYD said the plug-in hatch will redefine the segment as an affordable, efficient alternative. It’s now available to order, starting at about $32,000.
